premise: Beaver builds dens for everyone; Bear cub doesn't fit for three tries, until Rabbit suggests measuring and the fourth fits exactly.
inspiration: Goldilocks' three sizes, turned: nothing is too big or too small once someone builds it to fit you.
lesson: The right help starts by paying attention to who you're helping.

en-US.title: A Den for Bear Cub
en-US.text: {beaver:enter} Beaver {beaver:pulse} built the best homes in the forest. [excited] Who needs a den? The {bear:enter} bear cub {bear:hop} put up his paw. {bear:face happy} Me! Beaver built one. {beaver:face surprised} Too small! The bear cub's paws {bear:wobble} stuck out of the door. [giggles] Beaver built another. Too small! His ears stuck out of the roof. Beaver built a third. Too small! {bear:face sad} {bear:shake} The whole den wobbled and fell over, flump. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit {rabbit:hop x2} bounced over. [curious] Why don't you measure him first? So they measured the bear cub, from his ears to his toes. {beaver:face happy} Then Beaver built one more, {sfx:build} big and round and cosy. The bear cub crawled inside. {bear:face happy} It fitted exactly. {bear:live} He yawned, and stretched his arms up high, rubbed his eyes, patted his tummy… and nodded off. {bear:face sleeping} [whispers] Just right, said Beaver. {beaver:hearts} {rabbit:hearts}

es-ES.title: Una guarida para el osito
es-ES.text: {beaver:enter} Castor {beaver:pulse} construía las mejores casas del bosque. [excited] ¿Quién necesita una guarida? El {bear:enter} osito {bear:hop} levantó la pata. {bear:face happy} ¡Yo! Castor construyó una. {beaver:face surprised} ¡Demasiado pequeña! Las patas del osito {bear:wobble} salían por la puerta. [giggles] Castor construyó otra. ¡Demasiado pequeña! Las orejas le salían por el tejado. Castor construyó una tercera. ¡Demasiado pequeña! {bear:face sad} {bear:shake} Toda la guarida se tambaleó y se cayó, plaf. {rabbit:enter} Conejo {rabbit:hop x2} llegó dando botes. [curious] ¿Por qué no lo mides primero? Así que midieron al osito, de las orejas a los dedos de los pies. {beaver:face happy} Y Castor construyó una más, {sfx:build} grande, redonda y calentita. El osito se metió dentro. {bear:face happy} Cabía justo. {bear:live} Bostezó, y estiró los brazos bien alto, se frotó los ojos, se dio unas palmaditas en la barriga… y se quedó dormido. {bear:face sleeping} [whispers] Perfecta, dijo Castor. {beaver:hearts} {rabbit:hearts}
